canonical_claim.template: In 2025, Guild Mortgage Company denied {value} of its 23,298 decisioned FHA applications.

required_qualifiers.population: Guild Mortgage Company decisioned FHA applications (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.nature: historical institutional aggregate, unadjusted for applicant mix

does_not_establish: Guild Mortgage Company will deny any specific future application with 6.9% probability
Guild Mortgage Company is stricter or more lenient than another lender for a given applicant
Guild Mortgage Company discriminates or violates law
6.9% applies to Guild Mortgage Company's non-FHA lending
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
